title: Leonida Trophy Guide
summary: All 55 official PlayStation 5 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Every trophy has its official name, description and grade, a guide in our own words, its sources, a roadmap stage, and a missable flag where it applies. There are no online trophies: every trophy is single-player.
sourcesNote: Official names, descriptions and grades are taken from the official PlayStation list as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked with TrueAchievements. Guide facts cite the sources named beside each trophy: planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/, outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/, gtavicecityhub.com/achievements, and leonidahub.org/en/news/gta-vi-reportedly-has-55-ps5-trophies-platinum-included-as-xbox-and-playstation-data-line-up. Series mechanics that carry over from GTA V cite the PSNProfiles and PowerPyx GTA V trophy guides by name.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the six roadmap stages below: story first, then 100% completion, collectibles, activities, money and property, and finally the missable cleanup. Press reports put the whole road at roughly 200 hours, long rather than hard, so pace it in stages instead of rushing. Cheats disable trophies, so keep cheats off for the whole run.
sources: PowerPyx GTA V trophy guide — cheats disable trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Opening mission Gone Fishing. Treat as missable until confirmed: the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, so keep a manual save before starting it.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you follow the opening beats; do not skip its cutscenes or objectives. Because there is no mission replay at launch, make a manual save before you start the mission, just in case a one-off moment inside it is needed later.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 1. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save at the start of the chapter. One meditation spot in Chapter 1 can be lost after the chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter's final mission, make a manual save, because Chapter 1 also holds a meditation spot that can be lost once the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude). Clear the chapter's side content you care about before moving on, then the trophy pops on the chapter's end screen.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 2. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter and another before its final mission, because there is no mission replay to redo a missed one-off moment. Work through the missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 3. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Keep the habit from earlier chapters: a manual save at the chapter start and one before the final mission. The trophy pops when the chapter ends, and the story then moves into Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 4. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save at the start of the chapter and one before the final mission.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Before the chapter's final mission, make a fresh manual save — it doubles as your safety net for the final mission trophy that follows. The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: The final mission. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save right before it.
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. Make a manual save immediately before starting it, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch to redo it. Finish the mission and this gold trophy pops; the story trophies are then done except for any stranger finales you still owe.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Story mission Breakfast Run. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the story flow, so follow the mission marker when it shows up and play it through to the end. Save manually before starting it, since a missed one-off inside a story mission cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Story mission The Cartel Heist. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist set-piece in the story flow: follow its planning beats, then play the heist itself through to the escape. Make a manual save before it starts, since story missions cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Story mission Child's Play. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission marker when it appears in the story and play it to the end. Save manually beforehand, because there is no mission replay at launch.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Story mission Headliners. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks in the story flow; follow its marker and play it through. Make a manual save before starting, since story missions cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Story mission VCIA Takedown. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown in the story flow. Follow the mission marker, play the takedown through to its end, and save manually before it starts, since there is no mission replay at launch.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Story mission Operation Savage Glory. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named story missions in the flow; follow its marker and play it to the end. Save manually beforehand, because story missions cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Rockstar has not spelled out what 100% completion covers, so do not trust an invented checklist: finish the story, then work through the game's own completion counters — stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the rest of this guide — and check the in-game stats screen as you go. This is the second gold and the longest single grind after the story, so leave it for stage 2 of the roadmap, after the story is done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and driving tricks; they count cumulatively across the whole playthrough, so you will bank many of them naturally while driving between missions. For the rest, pick a fast car, find a ramp or jump you can repeat, and grind the remaining count in short sessions — the in-game stats screen tracks your total.
sources: PSNProfiles GTA V trophy guide — stunt counting carries over as a series mechanic

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The types are the game's side activities — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest — and one try of each is enough, no win needed. Work down the list early in the game so you learn where each activity lives, then the deeper activity trophies in stage 4 build on the same spots.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range, work through its challenge list one weapon at a time, and repeat any challenge until the gold medal lands — the medal is per challenge, so you can retry freely. Use the range's own scoring feedback to learn each challenge's target pattern, and save the harder weapons for last, when your aim and upgrades are better.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; a win at one does not cover the others, so visit every location on the map and win each race once. Learn the course on a first run, then race it cleanly — cutting corners on the gates costs more time than it saves.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so work through the race list and tick off a new one each time. Pick the fastest car you own for each race type, learn the first corners, and keep a note of which races you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Fishing challenge against Cal. Treat as missable until confirmed: the challenge is a one-off meeting, so keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spot, start the challenge, and out-fish him within its rules — steady reeling beats frantic reeling when a fish fights. Because the challenge is a one-off meeting with no confirmed replay, make a manual save before you start it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick any cabinet, and play it through to its end screen — one completion is all it takes, no high score needed. This is the quickest activity trophy, so do it during your first pass at the activities in stage 4.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission for Andy, a stranger strand. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Follow Andy's strand through its missions until the finale appears, then play it to the end. Save manually before the finale, since stranger finales cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission for Kenton, a stranger strand. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger strand until its finale unlocks, then play it through. Make a manual save before the finale, since there is no mission replay at launch.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission for Billy, a stranger strand. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its finale and play it to the end. Save manually before the finale, since stranger finales cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions, and the five stranger finales in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight. Find the remaining strands by exploring the map and answering stranger markers as they appear, and the silver pops on the eighth completed strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission for Randy, a stranger strand. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's stranger strand until the finale appears, then play it to the end. Make a manual save before the finale, since there is no mission replay at launch.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission for Tyrone, a stranger strand. Treat as missable until confirmed: no mission replay at launch, so keep a manual save before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its finale and play it through. Save manually before the finale, since stranger finales cannot be replayed at launch.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Every meditation spot. CONFIRMED missable window: a Chapter 1 meditation spot can be lost after Chapter 1 ends — meditate there before finishing the chapter.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The one confirmed missable window in this list is here: a Chapter 1 meditation spot can be lost after Chapter 1 ends, so meditate at every spot you find in Chapter 1 before the chapter closes. After that, sweep the remaining spots region by region and meditate at each until the counter is complete.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Unique-animal hunt for Bret. Treat as missable until confirmed: the hunt is a one-off stranger task, so keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, take the hunt, and track the animal with the hunting tools the game gives you — move slowly, watch the wind and the animal's trail, and take the shot only when it is clean. Save manually before starting the hunt, since it is a one-off stranger task with no confirmed replay.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, interiors and hidden spots; each set needs its full run of cards, so collect as you explore rather than leaving them all to the end. Keep a checklist of which cards you own per set and sweep one region at a time until three sets are complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole map, so this is a slow-burn collectible: hit every spot you pass while doing other things, and do a final region-by-region sweep for the last few. The in-game counter tracks how many locations you have done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's open-world task list — driving, shooting, flying and more — and they count cumulatively, so many will complete themselves while you play. Check the challenge menu regularly, pick off the easy ones first, and leave the long grinds for stage 4.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get your partner beside you, build the wanted level up to 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear — a fast car and a quiet hiding spot outside the search area work best. Do it with your partner present, or the escape does not count.
sources: PSNProfiles GTA V trophy guide — wanted-level escapes carry over as a series mechanic

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each one quickly with your partner, and keep moving between them without letting the wanted level drop — losing it between shops breaks the chain. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first get in it, so hop into every new car, bike, truck and boat you see as you travel — variety matters more than ownership. Driving through busy areas and car parks is the fastest way to meet new models, and the counter tracks your total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots through all five before the focus ends. If you only get four, reload and try a busier fight — the count must be five in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City airport). Treat as missable until confirmed: a one-off moment, so keep a manual save before attempting it.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Get a plane on the runway and take off without a scheduled flight — the game counts the departure itself, not a destination. Save manually before you try it, since it is a one-off moment with no confirmed replay.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks — until this trophy pops. Rhinos appear when the wanted level is at its highest, so build up heat in an open area, then survive the tank encounter: keep moving, use cover and explosives, and do not try to fight one head-on in a normal car. The trophy is about the Rhino encounter itself, not about owning a tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, take the goods and leave before any alarm or witness spots you — detection at any point fails the run, so retry if you are seen. Go in at a quiet hour and keep your exit route planned before you start.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Each vault is a planned robbery: crack the vault, grab the cash, and get clear of the police before the escape counts. Repeat at five different vaults — the same vault twice does not add to the count — and keep a fast car ready for every getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city: stop one, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the police. A sticky bomb or a hard ram stops the truck fastest; park your getaway car nearby before you strike.
sources: PSNProfiles GTA V trophy guide — armored truck robberies carry over as a series mechanic

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The counter ticks up as you enter each named area, so drive and fly across the whole map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps and the small towns — until every area has been visited. Check the map for grey, unvisited regions and sweep them one at a time in stage 3.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own illegal operations on the map; rob one per gang, nine in total, and the trophy pops. Mark each gang off as you go so you do not rob the same gang twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: One-off moment on Ocean Beach. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before trying it.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — the trophy is a single quiet moment, not a mission. No confirmed window exists for it yet, so make a manual save before you try it and do it early, in stage 6 cleanup at the latest.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: One-off moment in a vehicle showroom. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before trying it.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then smash straight back out through the glass — the trophy is the stunt itself, in the spirit of the classic showroom smash. Save manually before you try it, since no confirmed window exists for this moment yet.
sources: PSNProfiles GTA V trophy guide — showroom smash carries over as a series mechanic

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: One-off moment at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before trying it.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and complete the follow-through the trophy describes — bowl properly, watch the follow-through, and the trophy pops on the moment itself. Save manually beforehand, since no confirmed window exists for it yet.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: One-off partnership moment. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before trying it.
trophies.guide: Trigger the partnership moment with mass appeal. It is a single scene tied to a partnership in the game; play through the partnership content and the moment lands on its own. Because no confirmed window exists for it yet, keep a manual save before any partnership scene you have not seen.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices made across the game. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before major choices.
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — the description tracks choices made, for better or worse, and PSN tracks a count up to 500. Keep playing and choosing: story decisions, stranger choices and open-world calls all add up. Before any major choice, make a manual save, since choices cannot be undone and no confirmed window exists for the count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: One-off moment: succeeding on a second try. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before retrying a failed attempt.
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — second time's the charm. This trophy is about failing something once and then nailing it on the immediate retry. When an attempt fails, do not reload an old save: try again right away and finish it on the second attempt. Save manually before risky attempts so a second try is always available.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: One-off unexplained event. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save and explore odd sights when you find them.
trophies.guide: Witness the unexplained event the description hints at — something strange enough to make you ask what just happened. These moments hide in odd corners of Leonida, so explore unusual sights and events as you find them instead of walking past. No confirmed window exists yet, so keep a manual save before investigating anything strange.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: One-off moment: a melee drive-by that bowls someone over. Treat as missable until confirmed: no confirmed window yet — keep a manual save before trying it.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past on a vehicle and land a melee hit that knocks them down like a bowling pin. Pick a slow, straight stretch with a pedestrian target, line the pass up, and swing as you pass. Save manually before trying it, since no confirmed window exists for this moment yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to launder them into clean money, and the total counts cumulatively toward $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering in stage 5 and the trophy pops when the laundered total hits the mark.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending counts cumulatively in every shop — clothes, weapons, cars, food — so buy what you actually need as you play and the total climbs on its own. Near the end of stage 5, top the total up with a big purchase such as a vehicle or weapon if you are still short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you earn money and progress; buy each one when it appears and keep the cash ready — the trophy needs every garage, not just most of them. The last garage is usually the most expensive, so save for it in stage 5.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — any ten vehicles count, so use the varied cars and bikes you meet while exploring. Register them as you discover them in stage 5 and the trophy pops on the tenth.

roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission
roadmap.order: Play the opening mission, then Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4 in order, then the final mission. Do the six named story missions and the five stranger finales as they appear in the story flow.
roadmap.advice: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. The game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, so a missed one-off story moment cannot be redone. The Chapter 1 meditation spot can be lost after Chapter 1 — meditate there first.

roadmap.title: 100% completion gold
roadmap.order: After the story, work toward 100% completion using the in-game stats screen as your checklist.
roadmap.advice: Rockstar has not spelled out what 100% completion covers, so do not invent a checklist: finish the story, then clear the stranger strands, collectibles and activities in this guide and watch the in-game completion counter.

roadmap.title: Collectibles
roadmap.order: Meditation spots, then card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles discovered, and exploring all of Leonida.
roadmap.advice: Collect as you explore: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida. Sweep region by region so nothing is left for a final hunt.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.order: Try every activity type once, then stunts, shooting range golds, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, stranger strands, challenges, partner crimes, combat and robberies.
roadmap.advice: Counts that matter: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a drone race won at all 14 locations, 20 different races won, 8 stranger strands, 50 challenges, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs).

roadmap.title: Money and property
roadmap.order: Launder marked bills, spend in shops, buy garages, register vehicles — in any order, as the money comes in.
roadmap.advice: Counts that matter: $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, all 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app.

roadmap.title: Cleanup — missables, one-offs, and the platinum
roadmap.order: Sweep the one-off hidden moments and the hunts, then the platinum pops.
roadmap.advice: Check every missable flag in the Missables section before you finish: the unique-animal hunt, the VCIA departure, the Rhino encounter, and the eight one-off hidden moments. When all 54 others are earned, Vice Got a Price! pops.

notes.online: There are no online trophies: every trophy is single-player. Source: planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/ and outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/.
notes.cheats: Cheats disable trophies. Source: PowerPyx GTA V trophy guide; Rockstar Support confirmed the same rule for GTA V.
notes.time: The story alone takes around 60 hours and the platinum is long, not hard — roughly 200 hours is the press estimate. Sources: reviews cited by the trophy press, planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/ and outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/.
notes.noReplay: The game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch. Source: leonidahub.org/en/news/gta-vi-reportedly-has-55-ps5-trophies-platinum-included-as-xbox-and-playstation-data-line-up.
